story: Bees live together in a busy hive.
They fly from flower to flower for nectar.
Back home, they turn the nectar into honey.

story: The sun warms the water in lakes and seas.
The water rises up and makes clouds.
When the clouds get heavy, rain falls down.

story: A frog starts life as a tiny egg.
The egg hatches into a tadpole that swims.
The tadpole slowly grows legs and becomes a frog.

options.text: The egg hatches into a swimming tadpole.

story: Brushing keeps your teeth clean and strong.
It wipes away bits of food and sugar.
Clean teeth help you chew and smile.

story: Deep under a volcano, hot melted rock waits.
Pressure builds up until it pushes upward.
The rock bursts out as glowing hot lava.

story: A library is full of books to borrow.
You pick a book and take it home to read.
When you finish, you bring it back for others.

story: Moving air is what we call wind.
Wind can push a sailboat across a lake.
It can also turn the blades of a windmill.

story: A seed needs sun, water, and soil to grow.
Its roots reach down for a drink.
Then a green shoot pushes up to the light.

page_title.en: Marina's Headline Desk — What's It Mostly About? (Grade 2)

page_intro.en: Marina the otter writes headlines at the news desk, and a headline has to say what a story is MOSTLY about. Read each short article, then tap the card that names its main topic — not one small detail it mentions, and not something off the page. A warm Grade 2 reading game about finding the main topic of an informational text, aligned to Common Core RI.2.2.
